outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B shows H&E-stained micrographs of intestinal sections, not a plot.

Panel C contains a box plot (exempt from this check) and a 3D bar chart of polyp number per mouse by diameter category across genotypes. The bar chart shows only aggregated bars per genotype/size class with no overlaid individual mouse data points, so the underlying variability across the n=8-18 mice per genotype cannot be assessed.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), a plot type exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E includes a bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 relative to total, shown with an error bar but no individual data points overlaid, so replicate-level variability is hidden.
Panel F shows immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel G includes a bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars and significance markers but no individual data points plotted, obscuring the spread of the underlying measurements.
